LESSON: COMMON ACCIDENTS EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety
Topic 4.1: Common accidents Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Common accidents Education. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name common accidents at (8 lessons)
2. mention causes of accidents at home,
3. identify ways of preventing accidents at home,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Common accidents Education.
2. Explain Common accidents Education to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners tell stories of their experiences of accidents at home 156
4. Show that you can: name common accidents at (8 lessons)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Common accidents Education. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Common accidents Education important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners tell stories of their experiences of accidents at home 156
2. Learners identify ways of preventing accidents at home (wiping spills, arranging furniture properly, disposing off waste appropriately, covering open pits, proper handling of tools like knives and forks)
